cues.zh: 这是我的现实生活表情键盘。
cues.en: This is my real-life emoji keyboard.

cues.zh: 14个普通键盘，全都连接到这一台笔记本电脑，
cues.en: 14 regular keyboards, all connected to this one laptop,

cues.zh: 超过一千张单独贴上去的贴纸，
cues.en: more than a thousand individually-placed stickers,

cues.zh: 再加上一点特殊软件，让这里的每一个按键
cues.en: and a bit of special software so that every single one of these buttons

cues.zh: 都能打出不同的字符。
cues.en: types a different character.

cues.zh: 所有可能的表情都在这里，至少在我录制时是这样。
cues.en: And every possible emoji is here, at least as I record this.

cues.zh: 想要笑脸：就在你眼前。
cues.en: If you want smilies: right in front of you.

cues.zh: 动物和植物在这边，还有食物。
cues.en: Animals and plants are over here, along with food.

cues.zh: 我猜这差不多算是一回事。
cues.en: Which I guess is kind of the same thing.

cues.zh: 交通在这边。符号、装饰图形、运动和时间，全都在这里。
cues.en: Transport is over here. Symbols and dingbats and sports and time, they're all over here.

cues.zh: 右边是所有国家的国旗，还有一些杂项符号。
cues.en: And over on the right, we have the flags of all nations, and a few miscellaneous symbols.

cues.zh: 想在推文里加个亲吻表情？就在这儿。
cues.en: So if you want to add a kissing face to your tweet? That is right here.

cues.zh: 想在专业报告里放个弯月？就在这儿。
cues.en: Crescent moon in your professional report? That is just here.

cues.zh: 你那不太专业的报告里有个卡通风格的弯月？没问题，就在旁边。
cues.en: Cartoonish crescent moon in your less professional report? Not a problem, right next to it.

cues.zh: 黑人圣诞老人？安排上了。
cues.en: Black Santa? Got you covered.

cues.zh: 点一下圣诞老人按钮，再点一下那里的修饰符 Fitzpatrick 肤色类型 6 按钮。
cues.en: Hit the Santa button, and then hit the Modifier Fitzpatrick Skin Type 6 button just there.

cues.zh: 砰。黑人圣诞老人。就这样。
cues.en: Boom. Black Santa. There you go.

cues.zh: 它几乎包含所有 emoji，甚至连那些在任何手机或电脑上都还跑不起来的都有。
cues.en: It's got literally every emoji, even the ones that don't work on any phones or computers yet.

cues.zh: 想要一个穿西装的悬浮男人？点这个按钮。
cues.en: You want a levitating man in a business suit? This button here.

cues.zh: 我录这段的时候它还用不了，但等你在 iOS 9.1 上看到那条推文的时候，
cues.en: It doesn't work yet as I record this, but as soon as you view that tweet on iOS 9.1,

cues.zh: 等它发布的时候？
cues.en: when it comes out?

cues.zh: 就会有一个穿西装的男人 emoji，而且他会悬浮。
cues.en: There will be an emoji of a man, in a business suit, and he will be levitating.

cues.zh: 想对别人竖中指？就在这里。
cues.en: You want to flip someone the bird? Right here.

cues.zh: 想给别人竖一只真鸟的 emoji？这里有一打呢。
cues.en: You want to flip someone an emoji of an actual bird? Got half a dozen of them right here.

cues.zh: 企鹅、鸽子、蛋里的小鸡或破壳的小鸡，随你挑。
cues.en: Penguins, pigeons, a baby chick in its egg or outside its egg, your choice.

cues.zh: 比基尼、和服，还有茄子，那必须的。
cues.en: Bikinis, kimonos, and aubergines, obviously.

cues.zh: 想确保消息只对18岁以上开放？没问题。
cues.en: If you want to make sure your message is over-18s only? Got it.

cues.zh: 想禁止乱扔垃圾？这款键盘就是为你准备的。
cues.en: You want to ban dropping litter? This keyboard is for you.

cues.zh: 想在比利时禁止乱扔垃圾？很快就能实现？包在我身上。
cues.en: Want to ban dropping litter in Belgium? Soon? Got you covered.

cues.zh: 别管智能手机上那些花哨的触摸屏和弹窗了：
cues.en: Never mind all your fancy touchscreens and popup boxes on your smartphones:

cues.zh: 当你想要每个emoji都真正触手可及：这款键盘就是为你准备的。
cues.en: when you want every emoji, at your fingertips, literally: this is the keyboard for you.

cues.zh: 想知道它是怎么造出来的：
cues.en: If you want to know how it's built:

cues.zh: 本周晚些时候会有一个更长的视频，讲拼凑改造的艺术，以及到底
cues.en: there's a much longer video coming later this week about the art of the bodge and just exactly

cues.zh: 是怎么做出来的。
cues.en: how this happened.

cues.zh: 但没错。我造了一个emoji键盘。挺离谱的。
cues.en: But yes. I built an emoji keyboard. It's kind of ridiculous.
